(defn aggregate-pages []
  (loop [cursor nil agg {}]
    (let [page (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
          rows (get page "rows")
          nc (get page "next_cursor")
          new-agg (reduce (fn [m row]
                            (let [country (get row 0) amount (or (get row 1) 0.0) fraudulent (get row 2) current (get m country {:total 0.0 :fraud 0.0})]
                              (assoc m country {:total (+ (:total current) amount) :fraud (+ (:fraud current) (if fraudulent amount 0.0))})))
                          agg rows)]
      (if nc (recur nc new-agg) new-agg))))
(def result (aggregate-pages))
result

(let [ratios (map (fn [[country values]] [country (/ (:fraud values) (:total values))]) result)]
  (sort-by second > ratios))

(let [raw (read-all)
      countries (mapv (fn [[country values]] {"ip_country" country "fraudulent_volume" (:fraud values) "total_volume" (:total values)}) raw)
      top (first (sort-by (fn [[country values]] (- (:fraud values))) raw))]
  (println "Top:" top)
  (return {"countries" countries}))
